title: Foundations
paragraphs: Started Intermediate (MPC) at Sri Chaitanya Junior Kalasala, Hyderabad — finished with 975 / 1000.

title: Enter Computer Science
paragraphs: Began B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering at Malla Reddy University.
Won 1st prize in Logo Design at Anwesha 2K22 and was elected Class Representative for 90+ students.

title: Shipping for real clients
paragraphs: Joined Digital Connect as a Web Development Intern in August — the start of 100+ client websites across healthcare, education, real estate and business.
Competed in METALOOP 2K23, a 36-hour national hackathon.

title: Founder mode
paragraphs: Founded ProjectKaro in January — a software studio that has since shipped 60+ projects with a team of 23.
Elected Vice President of the CSE department, representing 700+ students. Won 2nd prize at Techspardha Web Thon and completed T-Hub's BlitZ program and the AICTE AI-ML virtual internship.

title: Going deep on AI
paragraphs: Built SkinCare AI (DINOv2 + ResNet50), quantum-inspired research systems, RAG agents and full-stack health platforms.
Completed Google Cloud's Gen AI Academy and the Deloitte Technology Job Simulation.

title: Graduate. Publish. Build local-first AI.
paragraphs: Graduated B.Tech with a CGPA of 8.97 and presented a research paper at PiCET 2026 (Scopus-indexed IET proceedings).
Shipped Cognora AI and India Invoice AI — local-first, citation-backed, review-first AI — and built an enterprise SOC lab.
